findings.title: [P2] Prove source-field rename from a revision that still contains the old field
findings.body: The supplied V3 controller creates the rename commit on top of the removal commit: it first deletes maximumSteps, commits that removal, then adds maximumStepsAfterRename. Consequently the purported rename transition is an addition relative to its immediate predecessor. Its stale-output rejection can result solely from changed evidence revision. Supply a direct baseline-to-rename case with original field present in committed schema and generated reference; reject stale old reference; regenerate and verify old row absent, successor/current source pin/ownership correct.

overall_explanation: SOURCE A911-10 FAIL at reviewed revision ee1a67d4aa21a8104625d6e7b2aa4e46c7b70120. Claimed source rename execution transitions from already removed field to newly added successor. Finite next proof: direct baseline-to-rename case. Other evidence supports bounded page-route removal/rename, declarative redirect disposition, owned successors, local link/anchor migration, provider-field removal and committed-input provenance. Neither deployed HTTP serving nor all84/native/fullGo/P17 established as dependency;54pre-existing metadata mismatches do not independently establish affected-transition defect.
